I just wrapped up an unforgettable 7-day, 6-night adventure through Leh, Nubra Valley, and Pangong Lake with Caravan Himalayas—and I couldn’t be more thrilled with how flawlessly everything was organized!

From the moment I was met at Kushok Bakula Rinpoche Airport, the professionalism shone through. Our vehicle was spacious and spotless, and our driver, Tsetan, navigated high-altitude passes with calm expertise. More than a skilled chauffeur, he was endlessly courteous—offering warm tea, sharing local stories, and ensuring every stretch of road was as comfortable as possible.

Behind the scenes, Mr. Inam orchestrated every detail with genuine care. Before departure, he walked us through a clear “Dos and Don’ts” guide for altitude acclimatization and local customs. Thanks to his patient answers to all our questions—big and small—we felt fully prepared and never worried about acclimatization or health concerns.

Each day felt perfectly paced: sunrise over Chang La, the moonlit sands of Nubra’s Hunder dunes, and panoramic views at Pangong that took our breath away. Accommodations ranged from cozy guesthouses with hot showers to a serene lakeside camp under the stars—each handpicked for comfort and local charm.

If you’re planning a journey to Ladakh, do yourself a favor and book with Caravan Himalayas. Their blend of local expertise, heartfelt service, and meticulous planning turned “my bucket-list trip” into a smooth, soul-stirring reality. Highly, highly recommended!
